Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study uniquely fine-tunes Mn substitution in low-Ni (0.65) Co-rich cathodes, a less explored regime. It reveals Mn surface enrichment and links structural changes to electrochemical performance. The optimal x=0.1 composition achieves 87% capacity retention after 100 cycles, offering a promising strategy for cobalt reduction and stable nickel-rich cathodes.

item.title: Interlayer‐Confined LiNO3 Reservoir Enables the Formation of a Li‐Containing Hybrid SEI for Robust Sodium Metal Anodes
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers an interlayer-confined LiNO3 reservoir in a montmorillonite-based separator, enabling sustained nitrate release to regulate solvation and form a Li/Na hybrid SEI. The Li-containing phases lower ion diffusion barriers, homogenizing Na deposition. This separator-engineering strategy achieves 4000 h cycling and 83.7% capacity retention after 2300 cycles, significantly advancing robust sodium metal batteries.

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work introduces a gradient-free LLM framework for scientific optimization, with two paradigms: Prompt-to-Optimizer and Prompt-to-Protocol. Applied to battery fast charging, it outperforms predefined functional forms, improving state of health by ~4.2%. Its novelty lies in using LLMs as representation generators to expand hypothesis spaces, enabling efficient search where evaluations are costly and gradients unavailable.
